authority_policy: Curated navigational map only; no clinical inference, no verified helmet safety, no evidence promotion without independent review

claims.statement: The facemask-shell-head collision simulation is a reduced-order three-body synthetic model, not a calibrated protective helmet.
claims.limitations: Prescribed external load, illustrative geometry, parameters and stops; no commercial equipment certification or injury thresholds.

claims.statement: A separately expressed RK4 solver permits numerical comparison with the existing toy-model integrator.
claims.limitations: Independent numerical implementation shares the same unvalidated physical assumptions and cannot verify concussion protection.

claims.statement: Offline nonhuman headform CSV and acquisition metadata receive structural validation and provenance checks.
claims.limitations: Data-contract validation alone does not calibrate instruments, verify timing accuracy or establish physical model agreement.

claims.statement: Current EEG and EMG streams are generated synthetically for interface demonstrations.
claims.limitations: There are no real neural measurements, diagnostic classifiers, human datasets or validated EEG biomarkers.

claims.statement: Current consent policy primitives are educational and do not constitute production medical-data security.
claims.limitations: No production identity system, storage encryption, independent audit, consent revocation propagation or athlete authorization.

claims.statement: Synthetic multiobjective design sweeps are exploratory parameter studies rather than helmet safety rankings.
claims.limitations: Toy-model Pareto improvements do not demonstrate physical head-neck or concussion risk reduction.

claims.statement: Quaternion head-to-torso orientation utilities are available as mathematical tools for later sensor work.
claims.limitations: No physical IMU calibration, coordinate registration, sensor clock validation or clinical use is established.
